purpose: Project-independent conventions for building plugins by combining SKILLs and custom Agents: naming, launch path selection, defense layers, skill invocation, and waiting for Agent completion.
summary: Naming rules: use short launch-path names, avoid bare "subagent", valid subagent_type values
Launch path guidance: custom Agents for isolated context, fork SKILL avoided by default
Decision order for choosing a launch path: Bash subprocess, generic Agent, custom Agent, inheriting SKILL
Inheriting SKILL: do not paste parent context into $ARGUMENTS
Custom Agent requirements: frontmatter fields, negative-form prohibitions, write constraints
Multi-layer defense table: Agent boundary, Role constraint, allowlist, physical deny
Invoking other skills via the Skill tool and forbidding self-invocation
Do not wait for Agent completion with ScheduleWakeup; end the turn and await notification
tasks: Designing a plugin combining SKILLs and custom Agents
Choosing a launch path for a delegated process
Writing a prompt or arguments passed to an Agent or SKILL
Writing SKILL steps that call other skills
Writing steps that wait for Agent completion
Reviewing plugin SKILL and Agent conventions
